Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and timeline. We're able to provide the penetration test artifacts you requested with standard redactions. A quick summary of what we can deliver and the constraints: 

What we can provide:
- Redacted full PT report (PDF) removing customer-identifying data, internal-only IPs, and any PoC exploit code.
- Redaction checklist (spreadsheet) that documents each redaction type and reason.
- Findings mapping CSV that links each critical/high finding to our remediation ticket and current status.

Constraints / handling options:
- If you require the unredacted report for your internal GRC reviewers, we will need an executed evidence NDA or a secure S3 link with presigned access.
- We prefer upload to your GRC portal (link you provided). If the portal enforces metadata fields we can populate them; alternatively, we can provide a secure SFTP or presigned object link.

Proposed timeline: 
- 2026-12-03: provide redaction checklist + findings mapping (CSV) for your pre-review
- 2026-12-07: provide redacted PDF to portal / link (pending your confirmation of accepted upload method)

Mina (InfoSec) will provide the remediation statuses and the CSV. Aditya will confirm redaction policy and final signoff.

If that works, please confirm whether you want the files uploaded directly to the portal or shared via a presigned link. Also advise if there are required tags/field names we must use when submitting.
